# tree-sitter-racket provenance

- Upstream: `https://github.com/6cdh/tree-sitter-racket`
- Revision: `v0.25.0`
- Commit: `b3cbbde75ce2de3079e33c7fe90bd41b1d45be48`
- Parser ABI: `15`
- License: MIT

The checked-in parser, scanner, query, metadata, and license files are an exact
curated copy of the revision above. The grammar supports Racket's default
readtable; unsupported custom-reader lexical forms degrade to ordinary text.
`SHA256SUMS` makes the offline inputs reproducible.
